messages.subject: bye bye rgdal
parts:
Hi everyone,
Thanks to a big effort by Ilya Maclean changing about 500 lines of code in microclima, both microclima and NicheMapR are now no longer using rgdal or the raster package so hopefully you can now install NicheMapR under the current version of R without any problems. Let us know if you do still have issues.
All the best and thanks again Ilya.
Mike
